title: Hades Essentials
description: This texture pack adds a variety of textures based on the game Hades.
body:
This resource pack replaces several essential Minecraft items with notable elements from the popular indie game Hades. 

Diamond Sword -> Stygius: Blade of the Underworld
Trident -> Varatha: The Eternal Spear
Bow -> Coronacht: the Heart-Seeking Bow

This is still a work in progress, and I will be adding more items, as well as improvements for the existing items.
